scientific_changes_from_development: none: generator/features/splits/model architectures/alpha/optimizer/100-round budget/checkpoint selection/certificates/diagnostic unchanged

confirmation.primary_cell_origin: selected on development validation data, locked before any confirmation graph is generated; no switching after confirmation
confirmation.evaluation: original test_sealed mask of each NEW confirmation graph; original development test masks remain sealed
confirmation.checkpoint_commit: ALL 288 selected checkpoint hashes and 96 graph bundle hashes written to exclusive checkpoint_commit.json before any confirmation test evaluation
confirmation.audit_split: audit_unused remains unused in all phases
confirmation.interim_efficacy: not printed or inspected during training or test audit; final analysis requires complete matrix
confirmation.partial_resume: forbidden: preserve failure and stop, no silent overwrite/retry/seed replacement

statistics.unit: independent whole-graph seed; nodes, clients and grid cells sharing a seed are NOT independent replicates
statistics.aggregation: unweighted arithmetic mean over eight seed-level metrics within each cell

bootstrap.method: paired whole-graph seed resampling with replacement, shared resample index matrix for all cells/metrics
bootstrap.interval: two-sided percentile 95%, descriptive with n=8; not simultaneous intervals, not a distribution-free confidence guarantee

statistics.primary_test: exact one-sided binomial sign-consistency test; success is paired effect strictly greater than null margin, zeros count as nonsuccess; p=sum_{k=s}^{8} C(8,k)/2^8
statistics.primary_test_estimand: Pr(seed-level paired effect > null margin) > 1/2, NOT a distribution-free test of positive mean; bootstrap intervals describe seed-mean effects separately
statistics.multiplicity: Holm step-down adjusted p over exactly the four primary hypotheses, family alpha=0.05; all four required
statistics.grid_inference: all twelve cells reported descriptively with seed-level data and 95% bootstrap intervals; no significance claims or post-test choice of a replacement primary cell
statistics.undefined_subgroups: rho=0 exposed is empty: subgroup metrics and intervals remain null, never imputed as zero
statistics.missing_units: no imputation or favourable deletion; incomplete matrix => no confirmatory decision

decision.primary_point_gates: same development_cell_gate thresholds as base protocol
decision.additional_requirements: all four primary Holm p <=0.05 AND bootstrap lower endpoint strictly exceeds each corresponding null margin, plus zero reliability violations and all resource limits
decision.claim_limit: supports only the locked synthetic generator/predictor condition; not real business validation, not rescue of E19-E24 negative findings, not accuracy/safety/privacy certification

hard_stop: analytic bound violation beyond inherited 1e-6 tolerance

artifacts.protect: all previous E28b development files, base frozen sources/protected files, main manuscript and submission package remain unchanged throughout confirmation
artifacts.paper_update: produce a separate candidate insertion; do not overwrite the protected manuscript/submission files
